description: The reserved agent group an enrollment group owns exactly once. It holds the agents that carry no agent group assignment, so the navigation tree has a node to render and the API an id to scope by.
comment: A separate interface rather than an instance of the ordinary agent group because it carries no ChildAgentGroups: it is a leaf of the topology, and it is neither renamable, movable nor deletable.

contents.name: Name
contents.description: Always the reserved literal 'unassigned'. Forms the path segment of this agent group within the unified namespace.
contents.comment: Reserved, so the API rejects any create or rename by a customer that would claim it - writable here means the node seeds the value, not that it can be changed afterwards. Never translated either: a path must resolve to the same agent group in every locale. Localized labels belong in DisplayNames.

contents.name: DisplayNames
contents.description: Labels shown for this agent group, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

contents.name: Descriptions
contents.description: Descriptions of this agent group, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

contents.name: Agents
contents.description: Agents of this enrollment group that carry no agent group assignment.
contents.comment: Bounded by the enrollment group's agent count rather than the per-group fan-out, because every agent activated without a group lands here and this group is exempt from per-group limits. Verified: the node does not enforce maxMultiplicity on write, so this bound documents intent rather than a limit the platform upholds.
